defs.def: the special set of clothes worn by all members of an organization or a group at work, or by children at school 制服；校服

ex.s: As I watched him take off his basketball uniform and replace it with a baseball uniform, I saw him leaving behind the layer that no longer served him, just as our lizard had.
ex.t: 当我看到他脱下篮球制服换上棒球制服时我看到他在脱掉那层不再适合他的外壳就像我们的蜥蜴一样。

ex.s: First, I wanted to be a fireman, whose uniform looked so coolly.
ex.t: 首先，我想成为一名消防员，因为消防员的制服看起来太酷了。

ex.s: There are several reasons why school uniforms are good idea.
ex.t: 如果运气好的话，在这个过程中他会吸引更多人的注意。

ex.s: First of all, uniforms help the school look smart.
ex.t: 校服是个好主意有几个原因。

ex.s: Uniforms can be useful in unexpected ways, A school in Ireland has introduced an interesting new uniform.
ex.t: 每个人都穿相同风格的衣服。

ex.s: But can uniforms help improve school standards?
ex.t: 当孩子们在昏暗的早晨步行或骑车上学时，汽车司机能够容易地看到他们。

ex.s: One study in America found that students' grades ___62___ (improve) a little after the school introduced uniforms.
ex.t: 这个问题的答案还不清楚。

ex.s: But some students didn't want ___63___ (wear) the uniform.
ex.t: 美国的一项研究发现，学校引入校服后学生的成绩略有提高。

ex.s: Other American studies showed no ___64___(connect) between uniforms and school performance.
ex.t: 但有些学生不想穿校服。

ex.s: School uniforms are ___65___ (tradition) in Britain, but some schools are starting to get rid of them.
ex.t: 美国的其他研究表明校服与学校表现之间没有任何关联。

ex.s: Some very good schools don't have a uniform policy.
ex.t: 校服在英国是传统的，但有些学校开始取消校服。

ex.s: However, uniforms are still popular.
ex.t: 一些非常好的学校没有校服政策。

ex.s: Pupils at about 90 percent of British secondary schools wear uniforms.
ex.t: 然而，校服仍然很受欢迎。

ex.s: That might mean either developing a uniform way to mark videos and images, showing when and who they were made by. or abandoning phone calls altogether and moving towards data-based communications—using apps like Face Time or WhatsApp, which can be tied to your identity.
ex.t: 语音操纵技术可能会逐渐削弱这种信任。

defs.def: the clothes worn by the members of a sports team when they are playing （运动队）队服

ex.s: Wear a team uniform.
ex.t: 穿队服。

defs.def: the type of clothes that a person or group usually wears 清一色服装；统一服装

ex.s: Suggestions to the Head Teacher (1 picture) ·What to change: lunch break, school uniform, ...
ex.t: 给校长的建议（图1）·要改变什么：午休、校服……

ex.s: We have to wear uniforms at school.
ex.t: 我们在学校必须穿校服。

ex.s: Unlike students in our country, these boys do not wear cotton uniforms, and many of them also have to walk a long way, sometimes for up to two hours, just to get to school.
ex.t: 与我国的学生不同，这些男孩不穿棉质校服，而且他们中许多人还得走很远的路，有时长达两小时，才能到学校。

ex.s: "That's what he said.'Earth' was the name He was dressed in a strange uniform and he spoke.
ex.t: “他就是这么说的。‘Earth’（地球）是名字。”他穿着一身奇怪的制服，说着话。

ex.s: The men went to the washroom, dressed in their uniforms and sat down to breakfast.
ex.t: 那些人去了洗手间，换上制服，坐下来吃早餐。
